column1: # CareNexus bundled ICD-10 catalogue: a subset of common ICD-10-CM codes for the type-ahead of the medical
# record form (TerminologyProvider 'bundled'). Codes outside this subset are still accepted when well-formed
# and are reported as unverified. Format: CODE<TAB>Description, UTF-8; lines starting with # are ignored.
# Guaranteed entries (tests and e2e specs rely on them): I10, E11.9, J06.9, J02.9, R07.9, R00.2.
